info.description: Private two-person relationship app. See docs/API.md for the design contract.

emailVerified.description: True once the email was confirmed (6-digit code) or came from Google. Informational only.

hasPassword.description: False for Google-only accounts. Decides DELETE /me confirmation: { password } vs { confirm: "DELETE" }.

shareLocalTime.description: When false the partner sees timeZone: null

timeZone.description: IANA id; null when unset or the partner turned shareLocalTime off

post.summary: Create an account
Sign in with email and password
Sign in (or sign up) with a Google ID token
post.description: Verifies the ID token against Google keys (issuer accounts.google.com, audience in GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS, email_verified must be true). Resolves by Google sub, then by email (linking; an unverified password account loses its password and sessions), else creates an account. Always 200; `isNewUser` tells whether the account was just created.

isNewUser.description: True when this call created the account

post.summary: Confirm the account email with the 6-digit code
post.description: Idempotent once verified. Wrong code: 400 verification_code_invalid (details.attemptsRemaining); the 5th wrong code kills it: 429 verification_attempts_exceeded; expired or none: 410 verification_code_expired.

post.summary: Email a new verification code (1 per 60 s, 5 per hour)
Rotate a refresh token
post.description: Every refresh token is single use. Presenting a token that was already rotated revokes the whole session family.

post.summary: Revoke the session (and that device push token)
Request a password reset (always 202)
Reset the password with a token from the reset email

get.summary: Current user, couple, partner and preferences

patch.summary: Update profile: display name, avatar, birthday, time zone, shareLocalTime

anyOf.description: 'YYYY-MM-DD', or '--MM-DD' when the year is private (Feb 29 allowed). Not in the future.

delete.summary: Delete the account (cascades: sessions, devices, couple ended, own media deleted)
delete.description: Accounts with a password send { password }. Google-only accounts (user.hasPassword = false) send { confirm: "DELETE" }. Anything else is 401.

password.description: Required when the account has a password (user.hasPassword)

confirm.description: Required instead of password for Google-only accounts (no password)

get.summary: Export my data (bounded to 1000 items per collection)

post.summary: Create an invitation code (shown once); creates a pending couple if none
Accept an invitation code and activate the couple
post.description: 5 attempts per 15 minutes per user+IP. 410 invitation_expired, 409 invitation_used / already_paired.

code.description: Case-insensitive; separators and confusable letters are normalised

get.summary: Get the active couple and partner

post.summary: End the couple (both members notified, shared media scheduled for deletion)
